title: Spiderstep Staff
summary: Grants Spider Step for traversing webs.

fields.Spider Step: Ignore the movement restriction from Web surfaces and avoid being Enwebbed by them.
fields.Weapon profile: 1d6 Bludgeoning one-handed or 1d8 two-handed, plus Strength. Simple versatile quarterstaff, 5 ft.
fields.Topple: Action with proficiency, once per Short Rest. Melee attack for 1d4 nonlethal Bludgeoning. Dexterity save against weapon-action DC +2 prevents one-turn Prone. No main-hand weapon effects.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
